slides.texte_overlay: Smile with your eyes. A real smile reaches the eyes and changes your whole face. People feel the difference immediately and warm up to you.
Give people your full energy. When you talk to someone, be there completely. No phone, no glancing around the room, just them. It shows they matter.
Tell stories, not facts. "Last summer I got lost in Naples" beats "I went to Italy." Stories pull people in and make you memorable.
Make others feel important. Ask their opinion, praise their ideas, remember their wins. Charisma is mostly about how you make people feel.
Before: I struggled to keep people interested. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and my stories got much better.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I struggled to keep people interested. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. My stories got much better.

slides.texte_overlay: Be comfortable being yourself. Your odd hobbies, your strong opinions, your quirks. People are drawn to someone who isn't hiding. That's what makes you real.
Bring good energy into every room. A warm hello, a light joke, real enthusiasm. People remember the person who made the moment better.
